verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure, so a workflow-composition layer is a fair thing to ask of it, but the pack shows no first-party workflow construct with loops, conditionals, or parameters. The CLI's step-by-step commands (start, navigate, click/fill, extract, stop), the Puppeteer/Playwright/Selenium control, and third-party orchestration integrations (AgentKit, CrewAI, the AI SDK) are developer building blocks or host-framework features. Any control flow would come from the user's own code or shell scripts, which earns no credit here.
